additional_info.body:
Hello Giuseppe,
Hope you are doing great.
I trust this email finds you in good health. We have received a technical support request from
La Linea S.p.A
in your region regarding the following product:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / P7 170000811
Charger ID/Serial No.:
u9YOAH
Problem Description:
HMI visible dark bright
Upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since [
07/07/2024
], as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
FYI-
Kindly find below attached troubleshooting steps
1. Kindly check the power supply (24VDC) to the control panel and ensure that the supply is reaching the Dlogic controller board as well.
2. Make sure the DP is replaced with a new one to avoid any interference.
3. Ensure the Dlogic is updated. If not, make sure to update it.
4. As mentioned by the customer in the previous email, the earlier ticket indicated a scrambled screen. Ensure it was replaced with the new generation control panel.
5. If all the above steps are completed and the HMI is still dark and unresponsive, kindly replace it with a new generation control panel. I'm sharing the MLFB and documentation for your reference to assist you in troubleshooting.
https://support.industry.siemens.com/cs/document/109816666/si-e-q-feedback-q2302-sicharge-d-hmi-backlight-off-and-scrambled-image-due-to-router-emissions?dti=0&lc=en-WW
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer. We have already informed the customer that a regional representative will be in touch shortly.
Should you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD.
For additional information, please visit the Service Collaboration SharePoint. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Mohini Patil
Please do not change the subject of this Email when replying to it
